description: Still-deployable historical disk-offload Candidate using the exact official native LTX 1.4.1 two-stage pipeline, BF16 checkpoint, distilled refinement LoRA, spatial upscaler, and Gemma 3 companion closure. The 89 GB startup and 75 GB steady declarations conservatively apply only the pinned upstream's documented 31 GB disk-versus-CPU offload reduction, with 8 GB growth and 8 GB system reserve for a 97 GB admission total; physical Spark acceptance remains pending. LTX-2.5 BF16 is the current fidelity baseline and LTX-2.5 FP8-cast is the current lower-memory canary; this immutable execution contract remains available for reproducibility.
